# What speed should I listen to audiobooks?
5 min read

The typical human speaks at around 135 words per minute.

It’s not that many people are looking for a Cowboy auctioneer (400 words per min) to read you the book.

## **So what do these speeds mean?**
I then took the total number of words in that section of the book - and divided them by the time - to get the words per minute (WPM) at that audio speed.

## But what speed can I understand?
The best way to get a ‘feel’ of word per minute speeds is to look at some of the typical activities we do everyday.

Reading WPM, turns out, is a bit contraversial.

## What about comprehension?
Be sure you don’t redline past your comprehension point simply to get done quicker.
